noJobsScheduled: No jobs scheduled for this date.
onlyAdminOrAssignedTechnician: Only an admin or the assigned technician can change a job's status
addRemarksAbout: Add remarks about what was done for this {jobType}.
whatDidYouDo: What did you do on this job/errand?
pendingInventoryNote: Each filter creates its own inventory transaction, kept Pending until an admin approves it — actual stock isn't deducted yet.
addJobDescription: Add a technician job to the daily agenda.
addSecondTechnicianPlaceholder: Add a second technician if this job needs two
sharesSameDateNote: Shares the same date, order, and status as the primary technician below — this is one job, not two.
linksTechnicianScheduleNote: Lets this technician see the job on their own Schedule. Unrelated to the Technician field above.
linkToSecondTechnicianLogin: Link to the second technician's login
linksSecondTechnicianScheduleNote: Lets the second technician also see this shared job on their own Schedule.
bothScheduledNote: Both {technician} and {technician2} are scheduled for this date — there's a single Date field for the whole job, so changing it moves both.
secondaryAddressPlaceholder: e.g. pull-out address, if different from the install address
noPendingScheduleApprovals: No manually created schedules are waiting for approval.
pageDescription: Technician job agenda across all dates.
searchByTechnicianOrderNotes: Search by technician, order no, notes...
deleteJobDescription: This will permanently remove this scheduled job.
locationUnavailableAdminReview: Location unavailable — needs admin review to assign a technician.
clearScheduleConfirmTitle: Clear the schedule for this date?
clearScheduleConfirmDescription: Unassigns technician, technician 2, and vehicle from all {count} job(s) on {date}. The underlying Filter Change/Collection/Repair records are kept — only cleared back to unassigned, ready for a fresh Generate. This cannot be undone.
scheduleAtLeastOneDayAheadHelp: Schedules must be created at least 1 day in advance. Select the date when the technician will perform the errand.
scheduleAtLeastOneDayAhead: This job must be scheduled at least 1 day in advance — today or an earlier date can't be selected.
errandDescriptionPlaceholder: e.g. Pick up water filters from the warehouse
errandIncomplete: Each errand needs a technician, a date and a task description.
workloadSummary: This week {weekDone} done / {weekAssigned} assigned · This month {monthDone} / {monthAssigned}
workloadTooltip: {name} — this week ({week}): {weekDone} completed of {weekAssigned} assigned. This month ({month}): {monthDone} completed of {monthAssigned} assigned. Counts Filter Change, Collection, Repair and Install records plus other schedule jobs.
workloadBarTooltip: {who} — this week ({week}) and this month ({month}). Counts Filter Change, Collection, Repair and Install records plus other schedule jobs; done means marked completed or given an accomplished/collected/installed date.
batchCompleteDescription: {count} pending job(s) will be marked Completed. Any Filter Change visit, install or repair they belong to is completed too, with an empty Acc D / Installed Date set to {date}; a Collection job's collection is marked collected; and filters or units used are queued for inventory approval.
fullScreenSearchPlaceholder: Search customer, account #, or job ID...
autoSuggestConfirmDescription: Suggests the nearest available technician for every job below, clustering nearby jobs on the same day together. Change any job's technician, companion, type, date, time, address, filters or notes, bundle extra tasks onto a visit, add custom errands, then Confirm & Assign to save everything and publish it to each technician's Daily Report.
noUnassignedJobs: Every job in this view already has a technician assigned.
vehicleCrewNote: The {vehicle} goes out with {crew} — both filled in below; you can still change them.
sourceAutomationHint: Created automatically by the daily filter-change automation
sourceAutoSuggestHint: Added in the Auto-suggest technicians modal
sourceCustomerConfirmedHint: Created when the customer confirmed the appointment
timeframePickHint: Click a date, or click two dates for a range.
timeframePickEnd: Now click the end date (or close to keep one day).
noJobsInTimeframe: No jobs scheduled in this timeframe.
scheduleHistoryDescription: Every change to schedule jobs — who added, changed or deleted a job, and when. Click an entry for the before/after details.
unscheduledVisitsHint: Confirmed Filter Change, Installation, Repair and Collection visits in this timeframe that no schedule job covers yet. Create a job to assign a technician and vehicle.
unscheduledVisitsCount: {count} unscheduled visit(s) in this timeframe — open to schedule
carriedFromFridayHint: Friday's unfinished work carries over to Saturday and Monday until it's done.
noCompletedJobsInView: No completed jobs in this timeframe.
noPendingJobsInView: No pending jobs in this timeframe.
bulkCreateDescription: One schedule job per selected visit, linked to it. The vehicle, technician and date below apply to all of them.
bulkTechnicianHint: Leave blank to use each visit's own planned technician.
bulkDateOwn: Each visit's own date (Friday visits go on Saturday)
bulkMissingTechnician: {count} selected visit(s) have no planned technician — pick a technician above, or they'll be skipped.
dispatchAllHint: Create an active job for every visit shown — with its planned technician, else the customer's technician, else the least-busy technician that day — plus a matching vehicle.
dispatchAllSources: {planned} with their planned technician · {customer} with the customer's technician · {balanced} given to the least-busy technician · {none} unassigned · {saturday} on Saturday left for technician selection
saturdayBannerTitle: Saturday coverage is assigned by hand
saturdayBannerAwaiting: {count} Saturday job(s) are waiting for technicians — nothing is auto-assigned on Saturdays, and technicians won't see these until you assign them.
saturdayBannerNone: No Saturday jobs are waiting for technicians.
saturdayJobsAwaiting: {count} job(s) are on a Saturday and wait for an admin to approve Saturday coverage.
redistributeDescription: {count} open job(s) and unscheduled visit(s) will move to Monday–Wednesday, grouped by area so each day covers one zone. Each is marked "Rescheduled from Saturday".
redistributeDone: Moved {count} item(s) off Saturday to Monday–Wednesday
draftBadgeHint: Pre-scheduled and auto-assigned by the system — pending admin review. Technicians don't see it until it's approved.
draftsApproved: Approved {count} draft job(s) — now visible to their technicians
draftsGenerateHint: Pre-schedule the next week's confirmed visits as auto-assigned draft jobs for review.
needsTechnicianHint: Saturdays are never auto-assigned — pick who's working with Assign Saturday Coverage.
coverageDescription: Tick the technicians working this Saturday. The Saturday's jobs and visits are split among them by area — change any row before confirming. Assigned jobs become active and appear on those technicians' Daily Reports.
coverageCrewNote: {crew} go out together with the {vehicle} when both are ticked.
coverageDone: Assigned {count} job(s) for {date} — now visible to their technicians
